name: canvas-api-guard
title_zh: Canvas 课程唯一合法入口，改分调课都走它
tagline_zh: 老师一句「把作业改到 90」你不再翻网页手点——它直接走官方 API 读改课程、作业、成绩、学生、模块。
tagline_en: When an instructor says "bump that grade to 90," you skip the browser and hit the official API—courses.
desc_en: Read and change an instructor's Canvas LMS course - courses, assignments, submissions, grades, students, modules, pages, announcements - through canvas_api_guard.py, the only allowed path to the Canvas API. Use whenever the user asks about their Canvas course or wants something in Canvas read or changed.
why_zh: 它把 Canvas 的 REST 接口收拢成一道闸，所有读写必经此脚本——权限边界、调用日志。
why_en: It funnels every Canvas REST call through one guarded script—auth, logging, and error handling locked in one place, far safer.
limit_zh: 只认 Canvas LMS 官方 API，且需已有课程访问令牌；不处理文件上传、SIS 导入、LTI 配置。
limit_en: Canvas LMS API only; requires an existing access token. No file uploads, SIS imports, or LTI setup. Stops at API responses—no gradebook exports or.
title_en: The only sanctioned door to your Canvas course
